main_text.p: הָקִים erigere, erige, Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. קוּם
הָקִים constitutus est, 2 Sam. 23. 1. pro הוֹקִים praet. Hoph. 3. f. m. Rad. קוּם.
הֵקִמוֹ stabilivisti eum, הֵקַמְתִּי statui, הֵקִמְנוּ statuimus, praet. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. & 1. f. & pl. Rad. קוּם.
הִקְנַנִי possidere fecit me, praet. Hiph. 3. f. masc. aff. Rad. קָנָה.
הִקִּיפוּנִי circumdederunt me, הִקִּיפֶתֶם circumdedisfis, praet. Hiph. 3. pl. aff. & 2. pl. m. ut & הַקִּיף circumuendo, Infin. Hiph. &c. Rad. נקף.
הִקִּיפוּנִי perfoderunt me, praet. Hiph. 3. plur. aff. Rad. נָקַב concidit, perfodit.
הִקְצוּ abraserunt, praet. Hiph 3. pl. item, הִקְצוֹת
abradere, Lev. 14 43. pro הַקְצוֹת, Inf. Hiph. Rad. קָצָה
הֲקֵר pretiosum habe, Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. יָקַר
הִקְרָה eruciat, praet. Hiph. 3. sing. faem. Rad. קוּר.
הֵקָה feeit ut aduenirent, הִקְרִיתֶם facistis accidere, הֵקָה facit ut obueniat, praet. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 2. pl. m. ut & Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. קָרָה
הַר, & הָר mons, No. f. m. contracte, à No. Rad. הרר
הֲרָאֵה ostende te, Imper. Niph. f. m. R. רָאָה
הֵרָאוֹת, ל הֵרָאוֹת apparere, הֵרָאוֹתוֹ ostendi ipsum, Infin. Niph. aff. Rad. רָאָה.
הֵרָאָה, vel הֵרָאֲה videre fecit, הֵרָאֵנִי & הֵרָאֲנִי me, הֵרָאִיךָ nobis, הֵרָאתִי tibi, הֲרָאֵם [?]

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points are faint and partly lost in the scan, so the Hebrew forms are transcribed on the consonants and may be off in their vowels. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "eruciat" (the scan may read "erucfat"), "facistis" (the scan may read "facisfis"), and the last Hebrew form on the right, which is bold and hard to read. The right column is faded and partly overlaid by show-through from the other side, so some Hebrew letters there may be incomplete. The page has no marginal notes and no printed footer. The Hebrew running heads are transcribed as printed; the letter heading "ה ר" is set as a paragraph because it is a bare letter.
